name: morph-button
summary: An async button that shrinks to a spinner, then draws a tick or shakes a cross.
props: Async work. Resolve → tick, reject → cross + shake.
Brand colour for accent, soft and outline.
ms the result stays before morphing back.
Minimum ms the spinner is shown.
Called with the resolved value or the thrown error.
Full width; shrinks to the centre while busy.
Taps on start, success and error.
Style for the idle label text.
Style for the outer animated wrapper (margins, alignment).
behavior: While the promise runs the button springs into a circle with a spinner. A resolve draws a success tick, a reject shakes with an error cross, then it springs back to its label.
Presses are ignored while it is busy, and the spinner shows for at least minLoading so fast requests still register.
A light impact on start, then a success or error notification when the promise settles.
A button with busy and disabled states; while not idle its value reads "Working", "Done" or "Failed".
